card.name: The word under before a noun
card.fires_on: The word "under" (also "Under") right after a noun or verb, where it begins a phrase like "under study", "under pressure", "under siege" or "under God". Weaker on small words like "to", "in" and "on" in similar spots.

modes.label: under as state or condition
modes.description: "under" introduces a state of being studied, pressured, besieged or threatened.
modes.example: Speaking of the ground, it too is<< under>> study.

modes.label: other small linking words
modes.description: Short words like to, in, on or expects link a verb or noun to its goal or setting.
modes.example: With the holiday season<< in>> full swing, so are our holiday traditions

card.writes: It pushes some Chinese tokens and words like big and gut, and suppresses name pieces; the effect is not clear.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "under" in phrases like "under study" or "under pressure".
